observations: Single photo shows one headlight/headlamp assembly, wrapped in clear plastic, sitting on a concrete/tiled floor.
Housing is dark/smoked with an amber-yellow turn-signal section on the top edge.
A watermark reading 'HONDA AND ACURA' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlays the image; this is text added to the photo, not a stamped part marking visible on the headlamp itself.
No visible OEM part number, connector, or bulb is shown.
No photos of the back/connector side, any cracks under the plastic wrap, or other parts (engine/suspension) mentioned in the seller's text.

claims.claim: Body, engine and suspension parts for all models of Honda, Acura and Toyota cars and SUVs
claims.evidence: Only one headlight is shown in photo 0; no engine or suspension parts are pictured, and no specific model is identified for any part.

claims.claim: Implied fitment to a specific Honda or Acura model (via watermark text)
claims.evidence: The 'HONDA AND ACURA' text in photo 0 is a watermark/caption, not a part number or badge visible on the headlamp itself.

claims.claim: Implied new/unused condition (item wrapped in plastic)
claims.evidence: Plastic wrap is visible in photo 0, but no clear shot of the lens surface, mounting tabs, or connector to confirm it is unused and undamaged.

risks.risk: Exact vehicle make/model/year this headlamp fits is unknown, which drives price heavily for this category
risks.proof: A shot of the part number sticker or stamped molding on the headlamp body, or seller statement with year/model confirmed by a matching part number
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced without this information

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, fog inside lens, or broken mounting tabs under the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens face, back housing, and mounting tabs with plastic removed

risks.risk: Missing bulbs, connector, or wiring harness
risks.proof: Photo of the rear connector socket and any included bulbs

risks.risk: Aftermarket vs OEM part, affecting value
risks.proof: Photo of any OEM/manufacturer logo or part number etched on the lens or housing

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any part number or model sticker on the headlamp housing or lens
Photo of the rear connector/socket area with plastic removed
Photo confirming exact car make, model, and year this headlamp fits
Photos of the other parts mentioned (engine, suspension) if a specific item is being sold
response.reason: A single generic headlamp photo cannot establish which vehicle model it fits, and fitment is the primary price driver for this part category; no part number or model is legible in the image.
